info.name: Get a list of outbound products

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter by product IDs. When set, other filters are ignored.

params.name: q
params.description: Full text search query for outbound product names, references or linked inbound product names, references or suppliers.

items.docs:
Retrieve a paginated list of outbound products for EUDR compliance.

Outbound products are products that your organization sells or distributes.
Each item includes linked inbound product IDs when BOM relationships exist.

**Use Cases**:
- List all outbound products
- Filter products by various criteria
- Export product data for compliance reporting

**Pagination**:
- Results are paginated (default: 10 items per page)
- Use `page` and `size` query parameters to control pagination

Create a new outbound product for EUDR compliance.

Outbound products represent products that your organization sells or distributes.
Provide at least `name` and `hsCode`; add `scientificName` and `reference` when available.

**Required permission:** `access_public_products`

info.name: Connect inbound products to an outbound product

params.name: productId
params.description: The ID of the outbound product.

items.docs:
Link one or more inbound products to an outbound product.

These relationships are used for EUDR compliance tracking and origin request management.

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `UPDATE` on the outbound product

info.name: Get a list of inbound products

params.name: ids
params.description: Filter by product IDs. When set, other filters are ignored.

params.name: q
params.description: Full text search query for product names, suppliers  or product references.

params.name: orso
params.description: Operator for origin request status filtering. Can be used in combination with 'ors' parameter.

params.name: includeOrigins
params.description: Url encoded query parameter for controlling if origins will be included in the response. It allows lighter response in case they are not needed.

items.docs:
Retrieve a paginated list of inbound products for EUDR compliance.

Inbound products are products that your organization receives from suppliers.
Use `includeOrigins=true` (default) to include origin information on each product.

**Use Cases**:
- List all inbound products
- Filter products by various criteria
- Review supplier, DDS status, and origin data per product

**Pagination**:
- Results are paginated (default: 10 items per page)
- Use `page` and `size` query parameters to control paginat

Create a new inbound product for EUDR compliance.

Inbound products represent products that your organization receives from suppliers.
Provide `name`, `hsCode`, and `supplierId` at minimum.

**Required permission:** `access_public_products`

info.name: Deactivate a product and its origins

items.docs:
Deactivate a product and its associated origins.

Once deactivated, the product is no longer available for active use in EUDR compliance workflows.

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `DELETE` on the product

info.name: Disconnect an inbound product from an outbound product

params.name: outboundProductId
params.description: The ID of the outbound product.

params.name: inboundProductId
params.description: The ID of the inbound product.

items.docs:
Remove the link between an inbound product and an outbound product.

The products themselves are not deleted — only the BOM relationship is removed.

**Required permission:** `access_public_products` and `UPDATE` on the outbound product
